collection.name: The Doll Club
collection.description:
The Doll Club is a club of silly dolls exploring our world -> no context, no opinions, no idea what any of it means. They turn up where they don't belong, stare at things they don't understand, and keep going.

A doll is the easiest character in the world to repeat. Redraw it anywhere, on anything, and it still reads as the same doll. Nothing to explain, nothing lost. 

Simple characters travel further than complicated ones, that's the IP.
